QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_12

question.text: Under the Compliance Test Report (CTR) framework, the Investment Manager must submit the CTR to the Sponsor/Trustee within:

answer.text: 30 days of the end of the financial year
45 days of the end of the financial year
60 days of the end of the financial year
90 days of the end of the financial year

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Master Circular dated 31-July-2023 (Annexure 14), the CTR must be prepared and submitted by the Investment Manager within 30 days of the end of the financial year to the Sponsor/Trustee. Sponsor/Trustee respond within a further 30 days; the Manager then incorporates changes within 15 days. The Trap: 45/60/90 days are generic audit-style windows but the CTR regulation is a strict 30-day window from FYE. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C / XIX-D test the CTR timeline across categories. XIX-B (distributor) rarely tests CTR mechanics. Manager's Pro-Tip: CTR drafting should begin in March for a March FYE — not in April. A well-run Cat III AIF maps its CTR disclosures to a standing checklist so Apr-30 filing is a formality, not a scramble.
